Author: AzeraKih
Name: Hide Beasts
Description: Automatically disables rendering of Beastmaster beast companions summoned by other players, to reduce visual clutter. Your own beast is never hidden.
Changelog:
- Keep Friends', FC members' and Party members' beasts visible - new options in Settings.
- Lighter and smoother in crowded areas.
Punchline: Hides other players' Beastmaster companions while keeping your own visible.
